verdict.rationale: New Relic does publish a public pricing page mentioning a 100GB free tier (new-relic-docs-13/14), giving some transparency, but there is no evidence of a detailed, itemized per-signal price list (e.g., per-GB ingest cost, per-user APM cost) that would let an SRE compute costs without contacting sales. Multiple community reports concretely contradict the 'predictable, transparent' framing: surprise ingest spikes from default log collection and JFR enablement, a 20x bill jump after a billing model change, and being billed 3x for non-prod environments (new-relic-comm-1, new-relic-comm-3, new-relic-comm-4, new-relic-comm-8), all indicating pricing is opaque and requires support/sales intervention to understand or control. missing for 10: a published per-signal price sheet (e.g., $/GB ingest, $/user), evidence of self-service cost calculators, and independent confirmation that costs can be predicted without sales contact.
